sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `minimax-code`
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-17
- Zero prior claims. GitHub repo is an issue tracker, not a source release. No stars claim.
- identity: The official product is MiniMax Code: MiniMax's desktop AI Agent / coding harness, plus CLI (mcode) and a Token Plan-gated Web surface. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-identity`, accepted)
- identity: MiniMax Code is MiniMax's desktop AI Agent app and the coding harness built for MiniMax models. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-desktop-harness`, accepted)
- status: MiniMax Code is a publicly downloadable desktop app with an active 3.0.x changelog through 2026-08-13. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-status`, accepted)
- vendor: Product branding is MiniMax. Agent ToS names the legal entity Nanonoble Pte. Ltd. (Singapore). (`claim-minimax-code-sf-vendor`, accepted)
- canonical_url: The official download / product page is https://agent.minimax.io/download. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-canonical-url`, accepted)
- repository_url: github.com/MiniMax-AI/minimax-code is the official issue-tracker repository for this desktop app. It is not a source release. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-repository-url`, accepted)
- version: The first-party changelog latest fetched entry is v3.0.65 dated 2026-08-13. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-version`, accepted)
- availability: Official desktop install is macOS and Windows. After installation, sign in with a MiniMax account. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-platforms-desktop`, accepted)
- availability: Desktop builds are public on the download page for macOS and Windows. CLI covers macOS, Windows, and common Linux/WSL. Token Plan gates MiniMax Code Desktop and Web. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-availability`, accepted)

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- identity: The official product is MiniMax Code: MiniMax's desktop AI Agent / coding harness, plus CLI (mcode) and a Token Plan-gated Web surface. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-identity`, accepted)
- identity: MiniMax Code is MiniMax's desktop AI Agent app and the coding harness built for MiniMax models. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-desktop-harness`, accepted)
- intended_user: MiniMax positions Code as a desktop AI Agent app for software development, everyday workflows, automation, and remote collaboration. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-intended-user`, accepted)
- not_for: Official download and install docs name macOS and Windows only. First-party pages do not ship an official iOS/Android MiniMax Code app. Phone access is Remote Control pairing and third-party IM. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-not-for`, unreviewed)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- primary_type: The primary surface is an IDE-shaped desktop workspace (Coding/Work modes, Files/Changes/Terminal, built-in browser, Review, worktrees). That maps to schema primary_type ide. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-primary-type`, unreviewed)
- agent_loop_owner: Goal mode sets a verifiable outcome and lets MiniMax Code keep working until the goal is achieved or progress is blocked, without a per-turn continue. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-loop-goal`, accepted)
- architecture: The desktop app primarily uses a local runtime and local data directory. CLI does not depend on Electron or desktop IPC. Host capabilities such as Browser and Computer Use are available only when the runtime environment explicitly provides them. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-architecture`, accepted)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- surface: The official CLI is mcode. It brings MiniMax Code into the terminal and repositories on macOS, Windows, and common Linux/WSL (not Alpine/musl). (`claim-minimax-code-sf-cli`, accepted)
- surface: MiniMax Code can connect agents to Telegram, WeChat, Lark, or Feishu. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-im`, accepted)
- surface: First-party surfaces are the macOS/Windows desktop app, the mcode CLI, Token Plan MiniMax Code Web, Remote Control pairing, and IM channels. No surfaces.jsonl rows were written this pass. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-surface`, accepted)
- surface: Token Plan marketing lists MiniMax Code Desktop and MiniMax Code Web. Plugin catalog distinguishes Desktop: MiniMax Code from Cloud: MiniMax Agent. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-web`, accepted)
- execution_location: The agent works on an attached local project. The desktop app primarily uses a local runtime and local data directory. MCP config is stored locally at ~/.minimax/mcp.json. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-local-workspace`, accepted)
- execution_location: A workspace is the local project directory MiniMax Code uses for a task. The agent reads files, runs commands, and reports changes in that directory. Scheduled tasks need the machine awake and the app running. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-execution-location`, accepted)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- model_strategy: MiniMax Code is designed for MiniMax M3 and can also use a MiniMax API key or a custom BYOK provider. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-model-strategy`, accepted)
- auth_strategy: Sign-in is a MiniMax account. Models can be MiniMax-managed, a MiniMax API key, or a custom provider. CLI uses mcode provider for a MiniMax API key or a compatible custom provider. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-auth-strategy`, accepted)
- byok: The official Custom Models / BYOK page lets operators add a custom model provider with base URL, API key, API format, and model names, or use their own MiniMax API key. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-byok`, accepted)
- local_models: left off (local workspace is execution_location, not local_models)

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body: - memory: Memory is a documented MiniMax Code product feature. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-memory`, accepted)

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- mcp: MCP is a documented product feature. Config is stored locally at ~/.minimax/mcp.json. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-mcp`, accepted)
- skills: Skills are a documented MiniMax Code product feature. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-skills`, accepted)

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body: - orchestration: Agent Team is a multi-agent system led by one main agent. It decomposes, executes, tracks progress, and synthesizes, with a Producer + Verifier adversarial harness loop. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-loop-team`, accepted)

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- permissions: First-party permissions docs require confirmation for files, commands, and external side effects. Reads outside the workspace need approval. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-permissions`, accepted)
- isolation/sandbox: left off / unattested. Permissions and worktrees only.

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- pricing: The harness seat is a MiniMax Token Plan / in-app package, not $0. Live download packages: Plus $20 / month, Max $50 / month, Ultra $70 (was $120) / month. Token Plan docs still list Ultra $120 / month. Ultra list price disagrees across pages; do not invent a single Ultra. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-pricing-token-plan`, accepted)
- license: The product repo has no LICENSE file and GitHub license is null. README says (c) 2026 MiniMax. All rights reserved. Agent ToS reserves all rights not expressly granted. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-license-arr`, accepted)
- maintenance: First-party changelog continues through v3.0.65 on 2026-08-13. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-maintenance`, accepted)

sections.heading: Lineage and compatibility edges
sections.body: - lineage: MiniMax says MiniMax Code is built on a harness based on OpenCode and Pi, and plans to open-source the project in the future. That future OSS is not shipped. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-lineage`, accepted)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- unique_value: Vendor positioning is a MiniMax-trained desktop/CLI harness for M3 with Goal keep-working, Agent Team Producer/Verifier, explicit BYOK, and Token Plan Desktop/Web. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-unique-value`, unreviewed)
- drawback: The product is proprietary ARR with a paid Token Plan seat. Ultra list price disagrees across the download page ($70) and Token Plan docs ($120). No product sandbox spec. Computer Use was temporarily disabled in changelog v3.0.46. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-drawback`, unreviewed)
- intended_user: MiniMax positions Code as a desktop AI Agent app for software development, everyday workflows, automation, and remote collaboration. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-intended-user`, accepted)
- not_for: Official download and install docs name macOS and Windows only. First-party pages do not ship an official iOS/Android MiniMax Code app. Phone access is Remote Control pairing and third-party IM. (`claim-minimax-code-sf-not-for`, unreviewed)
